statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.9.
The service performed is CPT 93247 (long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study).
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
